overview_description.description: Planet Memes Studio is a Dubai-based Web3 gaming studio and blockchain gaming platform that combines meme culture, cryptocurrency, NFTs, and play-to-earn gaming experiences. Founded in 2022, the company develops blockchain-powered games where players can earn meme coins, NFTs, and in-game rewards while participating in a decentralised gaming ecosystem.

product.name: Clash of Memes
product.description: A game that incorporates meme coins and NFTs, offering a deflationary model where NFTs hold value in meme coins.

product.name: Pepe Match
product.description: A Match 3 game that integrates the Pepe meme, providing entertainment and rewards.

product.name: Meme Coin Mania
product.description: A game mentioned as coming soon, expected to integrate meme coin utilization.

product.name: Memes Wallet
product.description: A wallet service for meme coin enthusiasts, supporting transactions without requiring registration or personal information.

product.name: MemeNFT Reserve Model
product.description: A model that ensures NFTs in specific games retain 50% of their value in meme coins, adding scarcity and value.

product.name: Marketplace
product.description: An online platform for purchasing in-game items and skins to enhance the gaming experience.
